<!-- generated by tools/gen_settings.py from the official proteus_f7 ini (config hash 1972639898); do not edit -->

| TunerStudio label | Setting | Units | Range | Help (as TunerStudio shows it) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Enable misfire detection | `misfireDetectionEnabled` | choice |  | Misfire Detection: master enable. Active at idle only. Latches check-engine light (P0300) once the count threshold is reached. |
| Count threshold (latches MIL) | `misfireCountThreshold` | events | 0 … 10000 | Misfire Detection: total counted misfires before the MIL latches. 0 = monitor-only. |
| Min flagged firings in window | `misfireConsecutiveCount` | events | 1 … 20 | Misfire Detection: minimum flagged firings within the recent-firings window before a misfire is counted. |
| Window size (recent firings) | `misfireWindowFirings` | firings | 1 … 32 | Misfire Detection: sliding window size in firings across all cylinders. |
| K multiplier (sensitivity) | `misfireK` |  | 0.5 … 20 | Misfire Detection: threshold multiplier (baseline + K * wobble). Default 3.0. |
| Window start (deg after TDC) | `misfireWindowStart` | deg | 0 … 360 | Misfire Detection: window start, degrees after each cylinder's TDC. |
| Window end (deg after TDC) | `misfireWindowEnd` | deg | 0 … 360 | Misfire Detection: window end, degrees after each cylinder's TDC. |
| EMA alpha decel (engine slowing) | `misfireEmaAlphaDecel` |  | 0.001 … 1 | Misfire Detection: EMA alpha when segment is slowing (above baseline). |
| EMA alpha accel (engine faster) | `misfireEmaAlphaAccel` |  | 0.001 … 1 | Misfire Detection: EMA alpha when segment is recovering (below baseline). |
| Wobble alpha rise (engine rougher) | `misfireWobbleAlphaRise` |  | 0.001 … 1 | Misfire Detection: wobble EMA alpha when spread is increasing. |
| Wobble alpha fall (engine smoother) | `misfireWobbleAlphaFall` |  | 0.001 … 1 | Misfire Detection: wobble EMA alpha when spread is decreasing. |
| Settle cycles before detection | `misfireSettleCycles` | cycles | 0 … 5000 | Misfire Detection: firings to wait after entering idle before flagging starts. 0 = immediate. |
